aboutme: Hello, my name is Heriberto and I'm a Software Engineer with experience across diverse projects and technologies, and a strong passion for innovation. I dream of using my skills to guide anyone stepping into the world of technology.
devstack: My main technologies belong to the Javascript and Typescript ecosystem, and I'm proficient in both languages. I have experience with React and Vue through multiple projects and their surrounding ecosystems. I work with the Git version control system along with Github and Gitlab. I also use platforms like Jira, Slack, Figma and Trello on a daily basis.
myexperience: Over the last five years, I've dived into the world of software development. While it may seem like a short time, it has been filled with learnings, challenges, and innovative solutions. Below, I invite you to explore the projects I've taken on.
wanabana_description: At Wanabana.io, I built components using React.js and Sass. I also took part in mentoring and led a small frontend team.
mac_description: At Hospitales Mac, I was responsible for designing, developing, maintaining, and refactoring various components, including full, complex forms. I worked with React, Redux, and Material UI, among other tools from the React ecosystem. I applied my UI/UX skills to create interfaces that were visually appealing, highly functional, and tailored to the needs of the hospital system. I also managed several databases using tools like DBeaver and PostgreSQL, ensuring data accuracy, accessibility, and security.
hmh_description: At HMH Sistemas, I used Vue.js 2 and React.js to develop and refactor projects. I took part in the refactor of the main HMH page, strengthening best practices, debugging, teamwork, and project leadership.
my_description: Web developer with experience in designing and developing web applications using various technologies and their ecosystems. Creating solutions, always one coffee at a time.
